column3: Freddie Mac FMHPI national nominal YoY growth ROLLS OVER: (Leg 1, direction) the June-2026-data or July-2026-data release prints YoY below the prior month's YoY as published in that same release — ending the post-trough acceleration run (Jan +0.9% revised trough → Apr +1.4% → May +1.9%); AND (Leg 2, level) any release covering Jun/Jul/Aug 2026 data prints YoY ≤ +1.0%. CONFIRMED requires BOTH legs by the Aug-2026-data release; otherwise MISSED (grade leg-by-leg in Outcome).

column10: METRIC (exact): Freddie Mac House Price Index (FMHPI), NATIONAL, headline YoY % as published in Freddie's monthly release (freddiemac.com/research/indices/house-price-index; CalculatedRisk mirrors same-day). Release cadence ~last business day of month: Jun data ~Jul 30, Jul data ~Aug 31, Aug data ~Sep 30. REVISION RULE: grade on each release's as-published headline figures (FMHPI revises history monthly — the inherited "Mar +0.7% cycle low" was a vintage print, revised away; May-release trough = Jan 2026 +0.9%, verified via CalculatedRisk 2026-06-30 post, checked 2026-07-12). MECHANISM: Realtor.com median list price -2.4% YoY May 2026 (steepest decline since 2017, rel Jun 2026) leads close-price HPI by the 60-90d list-to-close lag → Jun-Aug close data should carry the weakness; corroborating: existing-home median +1.8% YoY Jun (NAR, rel Jul 9, decelerating), Case-Shiller real YoY negative 11 consecutive months. BASE RATE (honest): ≤+1.0% = return to the Jan trough band printed 4-5 months ago, not an extreme level call — the discriminating content is DIRECTION (rollover vs continued reaccel off the trough); naive persistence of the current +0.5pp/mo accel would say MISS, the list-price lead says HIT — that tension is the bet. IF CONFIRMED: nominal-reframe risk to HPI-linked wealth-effect reads → push to HENRY via NEXUS_BRIEF; feeds CARL's housing-consumer context. IF MISSED/FALSIFIED: the Realtor.com list-price series loses standing as a reliable 60-90d HPI lead in HOMER's toolkit — log to LESSONS.md (leading-indicator failure, not just a missed call). Year-verify discipline per LESSONS.md applied at registration (all sources 2026-stamped). >> 2026-07-31 RESOLVER CHECK — NOT GRADED, PRINT NOT OUT. The June-2026-data FMHPI release was due ~this date (last business day) and had not posted/indexed at session time. NOT A DELAY IN THE PREDICTION — a delay in the release. Grading sheet's "release delayed/missing" row applied verbatim: did NOT substitute Case-Shiller or FHFA. ⚠️ NEAR-MISS LOGGED: three searches returned CalculatedRisk's June-2025 article (June +2.0% YoY vs May +2.3%) with the engine asserting it as 2026 data; direct fetch showed pub date 2025-07-31. Had it been graded it would have read J<M = FALSE CONFIRM of Leg-1. Caught by the LESSONS.md year-verify rule; new LESSONS entry added on confirming-direction bias. CONTEXT PULLED INSTEAD (non-resolving, per spec): Case-Shiller May (rel 7/28) national +1.1% YoY ACCELERATING from Apr +0.9% — nominal mechanism NOT yet visible, a headwind for Leg 1; BUT Case-Shiller MoM SA -0.05% (leading edge flat-to-negative) and FMHPI's own May +1.9% baseline unrevised at last look. Leg-1 now rides the June-data print (whenever it posts) and the Jul-data print (~Aug 31, last chance). Triggers UNCHANGED — no re-spec on a missed print.

column10: METRIC (exact): MBA National Delinquency Survey, FHA loans, TOTAL delinquency rate, SEASONALLY ADJUSTED, as published in each quarterly release (mba.org, rel ~mid-Feb/May/Aug/Nov; CalculatedRisk mirrors same-day). SPEC-AUDIT AT REGISTRATION (threshold-spec-fails-before-world applied): SA path Q1-25 ~10.62 -> Q2-25 10.57 (-5bps: Q2 DIPS even on SA basis) -> Q3-25 10.78 (+21) -> Q4-25 11.52 (+74) -> Q1-26 11.88 (+36); naive YoY-persistence (+126bps) puts Q2-26 at ~11.8 (NARROW MISS) and Q3-26 at ~12.0 (cross) - hence the deliberate three-print window, NOT a Q2-only spec; the Q2 print (~mid-Aug) is a low-probability early confirm, Q3 (~mid-Nov) is the modal resolver. DRIVERS FOR: student-loan-defaulter feed (2.6M Q1-26 defaults, ~30% of FHA borrowers carry student debt, ~4x mortgage-DQ propensity per Urban), TOP offsets restarted 5/5/25, rate wall (PMMS 6.58 at 2026 highs) = no refi cure. THE BET AGAINST (encoded honestly): the 11.88% level is partly MOD-ACCOUNTING - trial payment plans count as delinquent until permanent workout + pandemic-era FHA relief expired 9/30/25 (per MBA's own release language); HUD ML 2025-06 permanent-waterfall conversions could bend MEASURED DQ down while underlying distress persists - that is the miss scenario. IF CONFIRMED: STATUS FHA row -> RED; route to CARL (FHA K-shape leg) + REGINALD (Path-C context via NEXUS); threshold band validated. IF MISSED via both-quarters-decline: log to LESSONS as measured-DQ-vs-underlying-distress divergence (measurement regime can mask the series) and evaluate a mod-adjusted companion metric.
